posts.title: First Post: Welcome to My Blog!
posts.author: margoira
posts.summary: First blog post introduction about myself and my interests.

content.text: Hello, everyone! This is my first blog post, and I'm thrilled to share a bit about myself and what you can expect from this blog. This blog is one of many projects that will continue to evolve over time. I'll be covering topics related to software development, computers, and components.

I work as a Cloud Developer at M-Files, I specialize in leveraging Azure cloud services, Durable Functions, and Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC). I focus on developing user interfaces using React and have extensive experience with containerization, Service Fabric, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). On the backend, I utilize .NET for building robust APIs.
In my personal life, I have a passion for running and going to the gym, which keeps me energized and focused. I live in Pirkanmaa, Finland, with my two young children, a playful cat, and a loyal dog.

When I have some free time, I dive into the world of computers and enjoy working on small development projects. My interests include neural networks, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, with a special focus on image recognition. I also have a great time playing CodinGame and the strategy game Beyond All Reason.
On top of all that, I'm also an entrepreneur. In my side business, I build custom computers and sell IT equipment to companies. My company is called N-ele Oy.
Thank you for visiting my blog. I look forward to sharing more about my work, interests, and projects. Stay tuned for more updates!

posts.title: It's been a while?
posts.author: margoira
posts.summary: Second blog post reintroducing myself and my interests.

content.text: Good afternoon, it's friday finally. I have been quite busy at work and life in general, so I haven't had much time to write blog posts. But here I am, back again to share a bit what I've been up to and what you can expect from this blog.

At first...I started little pet project... well lets call it 'MakeHumanStrongAgain'. In general its a game, where you need to level up your own character by completing 'stuff' in real life. It is web service, but I like to classify it as a game. I have been working on it little by little, and I try to post update about it here in my blog.

Another thing I have been working is our company website. We used shopify, but because we are small company, we decided to move to simpler solution and much more cheaper solution. Basically it is static website, hosted in github pages. As it is static website, with minimal functionality, I coded it using plain html, css and little javascript.
When we deploy it to github pages, I will inform you all here in my blog.

As you can predict, Winter is coming. There is lot of good and bad things. Bad thing is that it takes lot of energy and time to dress up little kids and get them to daycare/outside to play etc. Good thing is that Ice Hockey season started! I like to watch Sm-liiga games, me and my daughter have been three times to see live games (Tampere Ilves). I also like to play ice hockey, and in this season I will play in Tampereen Dynamo. posts.title: Pet project
posts.author: margoira
posts.summary: Lets talk about my pet project

content.text: Tomorrow on 9th November, it is father's day here in Finland. So happy father's day to all dads out there! Let's see what tomorrow brings for me.

I mentioned my pet project in my last post. I will call it 'MakeHumanStrongAgain', I don't want to use real name of it yet. I have been working one important feature, which is very important if we think the big picture. Lets talk about it little bit.

To understand this puzzle, I need to explain little bit how this idea works. The main idea is that user creates an account to this web service, and in summary, the user adds exercises/activities for himself/herself. These activities has certain amount of points, so user will get points and level up own character with real life activities.

These activities can be for example: go to gym and bench 100kg, run 5km in 25minutes, score 2 goals in a hockey game etc. So user level up own character with real life activities....ok, but why?....Well, the idea is to get people to do more exercises and be much more active in real life. And because this is game, what would be a better 'carrot' than competing agains other users? So there is also Leaderboard, where users can see how they rank againts others. Different seasons and tasks which will give extra points.

What is the puzzle or feature which I mentioned earlier?...It is called exercise review. If user adds an exercise, the exercise will have status 'not verified'. User will get the 'verified' status, when there is evidence that user has done that activity in real life. Evidence can be for example: photo, video, data from fitness app, social media post etc. This kind of verification needs a lot of attention from admin, because it is kind of manual work. There needs to be a better way to do this.

If admin can only verify these activities, it will be bullet proof. But I don't want to spend my time to do this...One idea is to use peer review by other users. There could be some kind of upvote/downvote logic and comments. But this could be also abused? There could be somekind of groups, where high level users could verify these activities. But how to avoid favourite treatment or reverse?....One another way would be task AI to handle this verification. AI could analyze the evidense and users exercise history. AI could also recommend verified activities to admin for faster verification, I don't know...Lots of things to think about.

This kind of feature is important, because if it is implemented badly, it could ruin the mood of the whole game. If users feel that verification is unfair or too hard, they will quit using the service. If I get partners for this project (sport clubs, gyms etc.) there would be real rewards for users, then this needs to be bullet proof.
I will tell more about the solution when I have something concrete. Also fixed little style issues and added little pulse animation to logo.
